steps.text: A school bus is waiting at the village stop. On the map, north is at the top, and the school is drawn above the bus stop.
Which direction should the bus drive to reach the school?
steps.hint: On a map, the top of the page is north.

steps.text: Correct. Up on a map is north, so the bus drives north along the road and reaches the school gates on time.
Look at the compass rose: up is north, down is south, right is east. The school sits above the stop, so the bus must go north.
A map needs three things to be useful: a compass rose for direction, a scale for distance, and symbols for places like schools and wells.
Well done! You used the compass rose to send the bus north, and now everyone reaches school on time.
